title.en: An Act Converting the Sitio of Dunglayan in the Municipality of Santa Maria, Province of Ilocos Sur, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Dunglayan
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitio of Dunglayan in the Municipality of Santa Maria, Province of Ilocos Sur, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Dunglayan
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Dunglayan thành Barrio Dunglayan tại Đô thị Santa Maria, Tỉnh Ilocos Sur, Tỉnh into a Barrio
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Dunglayan เป็น บาริโอ Dunglayan ในเทศบาล Santa Maria จังหวัด Ilocos Sur จังหวัด into a Barrio
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Sitio Dunglayan menjadi Barrio Dunglayan di Kotamadya Santa Maria, Provinsi Ilocos Sur, Provinsi into a Barrio
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Dunglayan kepada Barrio Dunglayan di Perbandaran Santa Maria, Wilayah Ilocos Sur, Wilayah into a Barrio

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2527_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Dunglayan in the Municipality of Santa Maria, Province of Ilocos Sur, is converted into a barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Dunglayan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
